entries.alt: The risen Jesus holds a piece of fish while two disciples watch Him indoors.
entries.caption: Luke records the risen Jesus eating before His disciples. This scene illustrates that indoor witness, distinct from the shore breakfast in John 21.

refs.note: Indoor risen-body witness and eating before the disciples; room arrangement and precise expressions are artistic interpretation.

findings: The exposed left palm now has a clear small healed oval mark, distinguishable from an ordinary palm crease. The faint left wrist mark and clearer right wrist mark remain visible.
Christ retains the recognizable approved facial identity, with natural photographic skin and hair detail. His warm expression and gaze toward the disciples suit this joyful reunion.
Visible fingers, hands, fish and table relationships are coherent. The two disciples have distinct faces rather than duplicating Christ.
No material unwanted composition or identity change observed from the previously reviewed version. This technical pass is not owner approval.
